changes.title: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini snapshots (and their fine-tunes) shut down Jan 14, 2027; replace with gpt-6-luna

source.quote: On October 14, 2026, we notified developers using certain GPT-4 series models of their deprecation and removal from the API on January 14, 2027.

changes.title: gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.4-nano and gpt-5.1 removed Apr 1, 2027; replace with gpt-6-sol (codex, 5.1) or gpt-6-luna (5.4-nano)

source.quote: The following models are deprecated and will be removed from the API on April 1, 2027, with six months' notice.

changes.title: tts-1, tts-1-hd and gpt-4o-mini-tts removed Jan 6, 2027; migrate to gpt-realtime-2.1-mini

source.quote: The following text-to-speech models are deprecated and will be removed from the API on January 6, 2027, with at least three months' notice.

changes.title: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize removed Feb 26, 2027; replace with gpt-live-transcribe or gpt-transcribe

source.quote: On August 26, 2026, we notified developers using `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize` of their deprecation and removal from the API on February 26, 2027.

changes.title: /v1/audio/translations shuts down Feb 26, 2027 (same announcement as transcription models); replacement is v1/realtime/translations

source.quote: On August 26, 2026, we notified developers using `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize` of their deprecation and removal from the API on February 26, 2027.

changes.title: Legacy gpt-realtime, gpt-audio, gpt-4o-audio/realtime and mini variants removed Jan 20, 2027; replace with gpt-realtime-2.1, gpt-realtime-2.1-mini or gpt-audio-1.5

source.quote: On July 20, 2026, we notified developers using legacy audio, realtime, and transcription model families and snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API on January 20, 2027.

changes.title: gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-pro, o3 and o3-pro snapshots removed Dec 11, 2026; replace with gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna

source.quote: On June 11, 2026, we notified developers using older GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API on December 11, 2026.

changes.title: Reusable prompts and the v1/prompts API shut down Nov 30, 2026; move prompt content into application code

source.quote: On June 3, 2026, we notified developers using reusable prompts in the dashboard and API that reusable prompt objects are being deprecated.

changes.title: Evals platform: existing evals read-only Oct 31, 2026; dashboard and API shut down Nov 30, 2026

source.quote: On June 3, 2026, we notified developers using the Evals platform that the product is being deprecated.

changes.title: Agent Builder shuts down Nov 30, 2026; migrate to the Agents SDK (ChatKit remains)

source.quote: On June 3, 2026, we notified developers using Agent Builder that the product is being deprecated.

changes.title: gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest removed Dec 1, 2026; replace with gpt-image-2.5-sunburst or gpt-image-2.5-flare

source.quote: On June 2, 2026, we notified developers using older GPT Image models of their deprecation and removal from the API on December 1, 2026.

changes.title: Self-serve fine-tuning job creation is closed to new orgs and ends for existing active customers on Jan 6, 2027

source.quote: On May 7th, 2026, we notified developers using OpenAI’s self-serve fine-tuning platform of updates to availability.

changes.title: gpt-5.4-cyber removed Oct 1, 2026; migrate to the most capable cyber model available to you

source.quote: The gpt-5.4-cyber model is deprecated and will be removed from the API on October 1, 2026.

changes.title: gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest removed Aug 10, 2026; replace with gpt-5.6-sol

source.quote: On May 8th, 2026, we notified developers using gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest model snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API.

changes.title: Legacy GPT snapshots (gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, gpt-image-1, o1, o1-pro, o3-mini, o4-mini and fine-tunes) shut down Oct 23, 2026; replacements gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna

source.quote: On April 22, 2026, we announced the deprecation of the following older OpenAI models. Access to these models was shut down on October 23, 2026.

changes.title: Second batch of legacy GPT snapshots shut down Jul 23, 2026 (model list not fully read; e.g. computer-use-preview, gpt-5-codex, o3-deep-research)

source.quote: Access to these models was shut down on July 23, 2026.

changes.title: Breaking type change in a minor release: Live Decisions question instructions can be string or array of parts (openai npm 7.43.0)

source.quote: A Live response's Decisions question `instructions` can now be a string or an array of text, image, or JSON parts.

changes.title: Breaking type change in a minor release: DecisionItemCreatedEvent.item and DecisionItemCreateEvent.item are now unions; Responses image-generation default documented as gpt-image-2 (openai npm 7.44.0)

source.quote: `DecisionItemCreatedEvent.item` and `DecisionItemCreateEvent.item` are unions, so callers that directly access `item.content` or `item.role` may no longer compile.

changes.title: Breaking change in a minor release to Decisions types: question instructions may be str or structured list; more input roles (openai pypi 3.37.0)

source.quote: This minor release includes a breaking change to Decisions types.

changes.title: API usage tiers simplified from five to three (Build, Launch, Grow); rate limits may change per org

source.quote: Simplified API usage tiers from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow.

changes.title: New 429 slow_down and 503 server_is_overloaded error codes with Retry-After; retry handling may need updating

source.quote: Traffic that increases too quickly can return a 429 error with the slow_down code.
